content: Given a relation INLINEFORM0 and an observed triple ( INLINEFORM1 , INLINEFORM2 , INLINEFORM3 ) in training or testing, the pair ( INLINEFORM4 , INLINEFORM5 ) is regarded as a +ve instance for INLINEFORM6 . Following BIBREF18 , for each +ve instance ( INLINEFORM7 , INLINEFORM8 ), we generate two negative ones, one by randomly corrupting the source INLINEFORM9 , and the other by corrupting the target INLINEFORM10 . Note that, the test triples are not in INLINEFORM11 or INLINEFORM12 and none of the -ve instances overlap with the +ve ones.
